facts.fact: New Vision reports a NIRA statement of 3 June 2026 that registration of foreign residents is carried out under the Registration of Persons Act, CAP 332 (an Act), which NIRA treats as in force.

The NIRA statement of 3 June 2026 says that under section 72 of the Registration of Persons Act, CAP 332, registered foreigners are allocated a unique identification number, with an alien identification card issued under section 73.
